Changes.note: “Sign up” opens your Medaris account: your first and last name, gender, user name, e-mail, password and the privacy notice box are written to it. Your user name and e-mail cannot be used by another account. A verification link is sent to your e-mail; you cannot enter any portal before the address is verified. Tedris, Nazar, Nizam and tedrisat read your details from the account. The account cannot be deleted from these pages; you can change your gender later on the Account page in Tedris.
